injuries.name: Ivan Demidov
injuries.note: Demidov has been on injured reserve since Oct. 6, and he initially received a return timetable of 2-4 weeks. He's now at the end of that estimate, and while it's encouraging to see him skating on his own, he's still in a walking boot, per Eric Engels of Sportsnet. Demidov appears likely to miss at least a few more games, but another step in his recovery will occur once he's officially cleared to practice with his teammates.

injuries.name: Mike Matheson
injuries.note: Matheson to miss his second stretch of games this season due to a lower-body injury. It remains to be seen whether his current issue is a flare up of his previous injury. Prior to going down, the 32-year-old defenseman posted a goal, three assists, a plus-1 rating, 15 shots on net, five hits and 13 blocked shots across eight appearances this season. In his absence, the 22-year-old Adam Engstrom should have a chance to earn more playing time over the next two weeks and beyond. If Matheson is ultimately shifted to injured reserve, he's a solid IR stash in deep fantasy leagues.

injuries.name: Sam Montembeault
injuries.note: Montembeault will miss his 11th straight game against Pittsburgh on Saturday, but he participated in the morning skate and appears to be working his way toward a return. He hasn't logged any playing time in the 2026-27 season, and it will be difficult for him to get starts once he's healthy behind Jacob Fowler and Jakub Dobes.

injuries.name: Lucas Condotta
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Montreal Canadiens placed F Lucas Condotta on injured reserve non-roster list.

injuries.name: Ivan Demidov
injuries.note: Lower-body: The Montreal Canadiens said on Wednesday (Nov. 4) that Demidov has skated and could resume training with his teammates as early as next week, per Patrick Friolet of RDS.

injuries.name: Mike Matheson
injuries.note: Lower Body: The Canadiens said on Saturday (Oct. 31) that Matheson will miss two weeks with a lower-body injury.

injuries.name: Samuel Montembeault
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The Montreal Canadiens said on Saturday (Oct. 31) that Montembeault is considered day-to-day, according to Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports.

injuries.name: Bryce Pickford
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Montreal Canadiens placed D Bryce Pickford on injured reserve non-roster list on Tuesday (Sep. 29).

injuries.name: Maveric Lamoureux
injuries.note: Shoulder: The Utah Mammoth placed D Maveric Lamoureux on injured reserve and will miss 4-6 months following surgery to repair a dislocated shoulder.

injuries.name: John Marino
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Utah Mammoth placed D John Marino on injured reserve on Sunday (Nov. 1).

injuries.name: Nate Schmidt
injuries.note: Upper Body: Schmidt won't return to Thursday's (Nov. 5) game versus the Canadiens.

injuries.name: Kailer Yamamoto
injuries.note: Upper-Body: Yamamoto did not play in Tuesday's (Nov. 3) game against the Maple Leafs.
